architecture.state: canonical V6 state remains release authority
architecture.intelligence: Genesis discovers and proposes bounded candidate improvements
architecture.memory: proof, development, capability and strategy memories remain distinct
architecture.relation: capabilities are linked across donor lineage rather than copied wholesale
architecture.computation: sovereign PC may execute approved convergence/test jobs after heartbeat proof
architecture.action: typed allow-listed jobs only; arbitrary shell is prohibited
architecture.observation: source-backed Earth/archive observations stay separate from derived interpretation
architecture.proof: exact-head tests, evidence, rollback parent and material delta are required for promotion

product_alignment_directive.primary_identity: OMEGA is a sovereign computational environment, not a governance dashboard
product_alignment_directive.candidate_must_answer_acceptance_questio: Does this change measurably improve OMEGA at observing, understanding, relating, calculating, remembering, anticipating, acting, visualizing or proving?

all_modes_unification.rule: modes remain distinct source-backed operators, gates, weights, constraints, diagnostics or projections over the same Unified Operational Core packet; they are never separate applications or competing state engines

mode_188_dispatch.promotion_rule: candidate cannot be promoted from novelty alone; evidence and stability must dominate burden and contradiction

temporal_calculus_directive.purpose: make the governed computation itself visible instead of decorating static telemetry
temporal_calculus_directive.time_authority: live UI time must expose its authority and remain distinct from observation time, replay time and simulated forecast horizon

auto_update_directive.candidate_conflict_rule: stop stale candidate and reimplement useful capability on newest canonical head
auto_update_directive.visual_acceptance_rule: a visual candidate is material only when geometry, motion, topology, time or evidence display changes from actual state/operator inputs rather than labels or cosmetic motion alone

representation_boundary: 144/1728/20736 and larger values are software/model/interface state-space representations unless independently evidenced otherwise
